title.desc: Ask in plain English. Deckhand asks for what it needs, runs the calculation, and sends back a report you can keep.

turns.html: Can you size the sacrificial anodes for a subsea manifold to DNV-RP-B401?

Happy to — a few details so I run it right:
  • Wetted (submerged) area, and the coating category?
  • Design life?
  • Seabed seawater temperature and resistivity?
  • Anode type and unit mass?
This runs the DNV-RP-B401 screen for a fully submerged structure — current demand, anode mass, and a current-output check on the count.
Subsea manifold — 850 m² submerged, coating cat III. 25-year design life. Deepwater seabed at 6 °C, resistivity 0.33 Ω·m. Aluminium stand-off anodes, 80 kg each, utilisation 0.85. It's in the file.

Got it — a single submerged zone, so I'll run DNV-RP-B401 directly. Basis I'll use: current demand from area × density × coating breakdown (mean density 0.04 A/m² for the ≤7 °C band), total charge → anode mass, then a current-output check that the bank delivers the final demand. Running it now…

Here's the design — and it clears:
QuantityResultCheckVerdict
Mean current demand29.8 Afinal 34.0 A—
Required anode mass3,833 kg——
Stand-off anodes (80 kg)48output 46.1 A✅ Adequate
48 stand-off anodes (80 kg) — mean demand 29.8 A over 25 years, and the bank delivers 46.1 A, comfortably past the 34.0 A final demand, so both mass and current-output are satisfied.

report.title: Subsea-Manifold CP Design (DNV-RP-B401)
report.inputs:
Structure
Subsea manifold · submerged area 850 m² · coating cat III

Design & environment
Design life 25 yr · deepwater seabed 6 °C · resistivity 0.33 Ω·m

Anodes
Al stand-off · 80 kg each · utilisation 0.85
capacity 2,000 Ah/kg · resistance 0.261 Ω
report.methodology:
1 · Current demand = area × density × coating breakdown (cat III: initial 0.25 / mean 0.875 / final 1.0).
2 · Mean current density 0.04 A/m² (DNV-RP-B401, ≤7 °C band).
3 · Total charge over 25 yr (219,000 h) → anode mass (capacity 2,000 Ah/kg, utilisation 0.85).
4 · Current-output check: anode-bank output through the anode resistance vs final demand.
report.outputs:
QuantityValueNote
Submerged area850 m²coating cat III
Current demand (mean / final)29.75 / 34.0 Aover life
Required anode mass3,832.5 kg48 × 80 kg
Anode-bank output46.1 A0.96 A each
Verdict: ADEQUATE — 48 stand-off anodes satisfy both mass (3,833 kg) and current output (46.1 A > 34.0 A final demand).
